zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.8** 修复项目机器人执行中断、结果交付和日常对话交互，供继续评测。正式版仍为 0.0.18；全面验收、连续七天日用和正式版批准仍按原计划执行。

zh.title: 执行与结果交付
items: 后台任务返回结果后，主机器人继续核对并在主对话交付结论。单次回合让出调度后保留已有工作；重启恢复关联任务与待交付结果，避免重复派发、重复查询和重复交付。
普通质量要求由系统与模型验证，符合签收策略时自动收口。明确的人工决定仍在主对话提出具体问题；不再把普通检查误当作需要用户亲手验收的项目。
任务、列表和回复使用一致的当前事实；核验结束或失败后退出“核验中”。重试接续已有进展，真实预算耗尽、无进展、暂停、取消和权限拒绝仍会停止对应执行。
修复思考模式历史回传和 Grok 请求版本信息处理，保留供应商需要的原生消息内容，减少格式错误；服务订阅、限流或网络失败仍如实显示。

zh.title: 对话与界面
items: 机器人用完整段落气泡表达进展与结论；过程、调用参数、依据和技术诊断收至末行小字“查看详情”，点击打开右侧栏。
收紧输入框、按钮和页面留白，统一消息、后台任务和输入框的左侧边界；占位文案使用机器人名字，快捷输入选择机器人、模型和思考强度。
修复模型切换与思考强度控件的卡顿、宽度和激活背景；服务设置采用简短说明及对齐的图像识别选择。
会话引用使用紧凑来源预览，无装饰竖线。选中文字时，引用按钮紧贴选区；窗口、滚动与侧栏变化后重新定位，保留已有草稿。
页头更紧凑，“档案”改为“机器人设置”并直接进入设置页。任务详情优先说明进展、下一步与具体问题；依据使用可读名称，缺失记录说明实际可用范围，长错误完整换行。

zh.title: 升级与回退
items: RC4–RC7 可在“设置 → 更新与关于”通过自动或 Beta 通道检查 RC8。旧 Beta5/RC1–RC3 请下载匹配架构的安装包手动升级。
退出旧宿主，备份完整数据根，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级。npm 固定版本为 `@peer-agent/cli@0.1.0-rc.8`，`@rc` 跟随后续候选；归档中的 peer 与凭据助手须保持同目录。
**不要让旧版本直接写入 RC8 使用过的数据目录。** 新标准验证权限和协调记录可能被旧写入丢失。需要回退时恢复升级前的完整备份，并另外保留 RC8 数据及产物；无需为升级重置数据。

zh.title: 验证与已知限制
items: 确定性交互回归覆盖深浅主题、宽窄窗口、任务状态、键盘、流式段落、重试、引用、附件与设置。截图由实施者逐张自审，不是独立审查，也不代表真实云模型质量。
本地宿主退出或电脑离线时不保证继续执行；下次宿主启动恢复。真实服务订阅失败和部分响应超时仍有实测失败记录，不能当作已解决。
复杂写任务的命令描述 Evidence 完整性、跨供应商复核独立性、Windows/Linux 交互安装、生产远程、实体手机、完整读屏与长期日用仍需对应验收；总体 Ready 和 GA 未宣告通过。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.8** fixes interrupted project-bot work, result delivery and everyday conversation interactions for continued evaluation. Stable remains 0.0.18; comprehensive acceptance, seven days of daily use and stable-release approval remain required.

en.title: Execution and result delivery
items: The main bot resumes checking and delivers conclusions in the main conversation when background work returns. Scheduling yields retain existing work; restart restores associated tasks and pending deliveries, avoiding repeated dispatch, polling and delivery.

Ordinary quality requirements are verified by the system and model, with closure under the configured acceptance policy. Explicit human decisions still ask a concrete question in the conversation; routine checks no longer become accidental manual-acceptance gates.

Tasks, lists and replies use consistent current facts. Verification completion or failure clears the verifying state. Retry continues existing progress; real budget exhaustion, no progress, pause, cancellation and permission denial still stop the corresponding execution.
Fix thinking-mode history replay and Grok request-version handling while retaining provider-required native message content. Subscription, rate-limit and network failures remain visible.

en.title: Conversation and interface
items: Bots present progress and conclusions in complete paragraph bubbles. Process, parameters, supporting records and technical diagnostics move to a small Details action that opens the right sidebar.
Tighten composer and control spacing and align messages, background work and input. Placeholders use bot names; quick input selects a bot, model and reasoning effort.
Fix model-switch responsiveness, effort-control width and active backgrounds. Service settings use a short image-recognition explanation with aligned selection.
Quotes use compact source previews without a decorative vertical line. Selected-text quoting appears beside the selection, repositions on scrolling and layout changes, and preserves existing drafts.

Use a compact conversation header and rename Profile to Bot settings, opening configuration directly. Task details prioritize progress, next steps and concrete questions. Supporting records use readable names, missing records explain their limits, and long errors wrap completely.

en.title: Upgrade and rollback
items: RC4–RC7 can check for RC8 through Auto or Beta in Settings → Update & About. Older Beta5/RC1–RC3 require a manual installer matching their architecture.

Quit older hosts, back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Use `@peer-agent/cli@0.1.0-rc.8` for a fixed npm version; `@rc` follows later candidates. Keep peer and its credential helper together.

**Do not let an older version write directly to a data directory used by RC8.** Older writes can discard new criterion authority and coordination fields. Roll back using the complete pre-upgrade backup while retaining RC8 data and artifacts separately. Upgrading does not require a data reset.

en.title: Validation and known limits
items: Deterministic interaction regression covers both themes, wide and narrow windows, task states, keyboard use, incremental paragraphs, retry, quotes, attachments and settings. Screenshots are inspected by the implementer, not an independent reviewer, and do not establish live model quality.

Execution is not guaranteed while the local host is stopped or the computer is offline; recovery occurs when the host starts again. Recorded subscription failures and some response timeouts remain unresolved observations.

Complex-write command Evidence completeness, verifier independence across providers, interactive Windows/Linux installation, production remote deployment, physical phones, full screen-reader testing and long-term use still require their corresponding acceptance. Overall readiness and GA are not declared complete.
